meta.title: LORE — physical product studio for creators
meta.description: LORE designs and launches physical products for creators and bloggers — fully turnkey, from idea to delivery.

hero.body: We design and launch physical products for creators and bloggers — completely turnkey.

positioning.body: We build a product that naturally extends the creator's brand — one their audience actually wants to buy.
positioning.note: (for anyone tired of logo t-shirts in commercial proposals)

regular.note: And that's if you already show up with a finished brief
regular.restNote: Everything after that is on you:

us.note: You can come to us without even a finished idea.

services.body: We take on everything. From idea to delivery. You're at the center of the brand, we're behind the curtain.

production.body: We handle the entire path of the product — from development to delivery.

journey.eyebrow: From the floor to the doorstep
journey.body: The same object lives three lives: born on the production floor, comes alive in a creator's hands, and finds its person.

acts.title: Born on the floor
acts.body: Materials, samples, quality control — before it becomes a product, it passes through dozens of hands.

acts.title: Comes alive on camera
acts.body: The creator introduces the product to their audience — the moment that turns an object into a story.

acts.title: Finds its person
acts.body: The box reaches its owner — and that's the moment the whole thing was built for.

productDiscovery.quote: You don't need to come to us with a ready idea. “I want to monetize my audience, but I don't know how.”
productDiscovery.bottomAccent: what you should actually be selling

items.title: Stronger brand
items.body: The creator stops being just a media channel.

items.title: Loyalty
items.body: Fans can literally buy a piece of the creator's world.

items.title: Extra revenue stream
items.body: Not solely dependent on ad integrations.

showcase.body: From hoodies to tumblers — any merch format that fits the creator's brand.

columns.body: You put in no money upfront. We fund production and launch, you earn a percentage of every order.

columns.title: Pre-order
columns.body: Sales first, production after. We collect pre-orders from your audience; production starts once the volume is paid.

columns.title: Author invests
columns.body: You fund the product and keep the revenue. We handle production, logistics and services for a fixed fee.

cases.name: Rhode
cases.text: A year of organic audience warm-up before launch built pent-up demand — the brand now earns over $212M a year.

cases.name: Chamberlain Coffee
cases.text: A personal habit turned into a full FMCG product, on shelves at major US retailers and earning $22M a year.

cases.name: Skims
cases.text: Reinventing the shapewear market through size inclusivity and viral marketing — and, of course, a personal brand.
